carpet.rule.cofDebugCommand.desc: Whether the /cofdebug diagnostic command is enabled; 0-4 = enabled and only usable by players whose permission level reaches that number.
carpet.rule.waterCauldronFreezing.desc: Lets water cauldrons freeze naturally in rain or snow.
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingProduct.desc: What a filled water cauldron produces and how many freeze events each item needs: ice = ice every time, packed_ice = one packed ice per 2, blue_ice = one blue ice per 3; the count resets after every item.
carpet.rule.waterBucketNotConsumed.desc: Using a water bucket in survival does not consume it.
carpet.rule.waterBottleNotConsumed.desc: Using a water bottle to fill a cauldron in survival does not consume it.
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingChance.desc: Freeze check frequency: 48 matches vanilla water freezing, smaller values freeze faster.
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingRequiresFull: Whether a filled water cauldron must be at full water level to freeze.
carpet.rule.lowPriceVillagers.desc: Villagers sell at the bottom of each trade price range; only newly rolled trades are affected.
carpet.rule.reputationNoPriceHike.desc: Reputation can only lower villager prices, never raise them.
carpet.rule.righteousCompanion.desc: Iron golems never attack players on their own: they stop acting on village gossip and no longer retaliate when hit, and any golem already chasing a player gives up immediately - but once the rule is turned off they are affected by village gossip again right away.
Novice villagers never re-roll their trades because they lost their workstation on their own.
